title: Accounts Office Bulletin — Amounts Owed Set Against a Shortfall Payment, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Amounts Owed Set Against a Shortfall Payment

Bulletin of the accounts office on the offset taken off a shortfall payment on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. The recent months are the 3 months ending on the day of the payment.

## Rule

- Where the subscription stands suspended, the offset is everything the subscription owes.
- Where the subscription stands active or in its renewal window and an amount stands owed on it, the offset is the charges invoiced on it in the recent months ending on the day of the payment less the payments received on it in those months.
- In every other case no offset is taken off the payment.

## Table

| Status on the subscription record | Amount owed on the subscription | Offset |
|---|---|---|
| suspended | any | everything the subscription owes |
| active or pending renewal | above nothing | the charges invoiced in the 3 months less the payments received in those 3 months, held at nothing where that falls below nothing |
| active or pending renewal | nothing owed | none |
| any other status | any | none |

Charges are placed in the window by the day the invoice carrying each fell due, payments by the day each was received in the office.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A subscription standing active owing USD 2 400.00, with USD 1 900.00 of charges falling due and USD 1 200.00 of payments received in the last three months, carries an offset of USD 700.00. Were the same subscription suspended, the offset would be the whole USD 2 400.00 it owes; owing nothing while active, no offset at all.
